In Round 4 of the Asian Nations Chess Cup 2026, the Indian Women's team faced the United Arab Emirates C (Abu Dhabi) team on Board 4. On the top board, 1578-rated Rowdah Ghalib Alafeefi took on IM Vantika Agrawal. Watch this clash to see how the massive rating and experience gap played out over the board!
